location_description:
Glendale Heights is a village in DuPage County, Illinois, United States. Per the 2020 census, the population was 33,176.


== History ==
Glendale Heights was a small farming area served by the Glen Ellyn post office up until the 1950s, with a population of just 104 in 1959.
